text.trigger: A player moves a survivor who is not exiled.
text.vignette: A tanker truck sits crooked on the shoulder with its cab door swinging, and the tank slops audibly when you thump the steel. The engine would start; it would also be heard for miles.

options.drive-it-home: Drive it to the colony with the dead in tow: 6 zombies are added at the colony and you take up to 4 Fuel cards that have left the game into your hand.
options.leave-it: Switch the engine off and walk away. Nothing happens.
